plain: Not real; resting on a false hope

webster.text: Deceiving or tending to deceive by false appearances; fallacious.

example.quote: I will not expatiate on this subject ; but I believe many reasons will suggest themselves to prove that such expectation would be illusory.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 2, Pennsylvania Convention, Mr. WILSON, December 11, 1787 and the following sittings (Elliot prints no later date headings) (2d ed. 1836)
